description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You begin THE ORBIT.

THE ORBIT begins at full strength rather than building: this round and every round you Sustain it, it draws its subjects the full distance it would reach after several rounds of compounding, with no ramp. It is otherwise unchanged, and Sustaining it works exactly as it normally does.

cinderfall.incomplete: THE ORBIT begins at full strength -- no forced-movement/pull/drag rule element exists anywhere in pf2e-source (NOMOVE), so THE ORBIT itself is unbuildable and this extension has nothing to hook.
